entries.mechanism:
North Carolina's broad-based categorical eligibility (SNAP state option;
PolicyEngine models gross screen x2.0 FPL, x2.0 for elderly/disabled
households, at 2026-01 per gov/hhs/tanf/non_cash parameters) is not in
the composed us-nc/snap/fy-2026 program, which applies only the standard
federal tests. Every selected row is verified per-row against axiom's
persisted output surface: household gross income sits inside the band
above the federal 130 percent limit the composed program applies and at
or below the state's BBCE screen, verified against axiom's own computed
gross income and limit. Axiom-side modeling boundary, tracked for
encoding in rulespec-us#1098. Requested-month selector audit retained 9 of 9 rows; vanished cases: none; materially moved rows: 0.

Exact-household requested-month counterfactual on PolicyEngine 4.18.9, PolicyEngine-US 1.767.3, and PolicyEngine-Core 3.30.3: the fixed-runner baseline is Axiom 1183.0 versus January PolicyEngine 1161.699951171875, reproduced by the direct requested-period replay. PolicyEngine reports calendar-year nc_tanf 3724.00341796875 and calendar-year aggregate TANF 3724.00341796875. Forcing both the state component and aggregate TANF to zero at their native periods keeps SNAP eligibility True and produces January SNAP 1183.0; its absolute delta from Axiom is 0.0, within the unchanged suite tolerance 7.0. The legacy annual-average pin was 1183.0 / 1168.7794596354167 / 14.220540364583258; the requested-month pin is 1183.0 / 1161.699951171875 / 21.300048828125 (materially changed). Replay receipt SHA-256 38c0860662f48c8acc707456d5b21d79b9de2d29b2a9eb15931bdd2840f19436 reproduces the fixed 2026-01 baseline and counterfactual; material movement=true.

Reverified on PolicyEngine 4.18.9, PolicyEngine-US 1.767.3, and PolicyEngine-Core 3.30.3. The exact-household signature and explicit K-12 counterfactual reproduce the mechanism: PolicyEngine excludes all earnings of an imputed K-12 member age 17 or younger without requiring the co-resident-parent or parental-control condition in 7 CFR 273.9(c)(7). The sole minor is a valid household under 273.1(a)(1), but wages count under 273.9(b)(1)(i), so Axiom correctly fails the income gate and returns zero benefit. Requested-month selector audit retained 3 of 3 rows; vanished cases: none; materially moved rows: 3 (ecps-27147 right 150.64496866861978 -> 148.59999084472656; ecps-27597 right 198.19500732421875 -> 196.0; ecps-27962 right 150.64496866861978 -> 148.59999084472656).
